column18:
Breaker Effects have altered their passive effects since MoT.

Shield-Piercing can go through PHYSICAL BARRIERS.
(Bucklers, Hydra Barriers, etc) 
Still deals more damage to Barricades.
No longer overpenetrates enemies.

Overload's Disruption counts as Exhaust only for the purpose of Photonic Flare and Elemental Supercharger (Tablet Artifact)
It still lowers Guardian Energy Regen to 0.4x.

Exhaust-specific effects (Psychohack, Problem Solver, etc)
Decrease Combatant Damage by 25%.

Unstoppable has increased stagger. 
Galvanized 2  = ONLY Unstoppables can stagger.
